title: Intro Flow Drag Chrome Sync
description: When dragging text dispositions in projektetage intro (e.g. slide 6), enlarge and resize controls do not move with the dragged content.
summary:
Fixed intro flow drag so enlarge, reset, and resize chrome stay attached to the disposition.

Root cause: `translate3d` for flow pixel-offset drags was applied only on `__content`, while `.presentation-interaction-actions` (enlarge/reset) are siblings on the wrapper.

Fix: apply `flowDispositionOffsetStyle` on the disposition wrapper; prefer the offset wrapper in `flowDragTransformElement` for pointer scale. Intro drag test asserts wrapper translate and connected enlarge control.
